service.description: Run MRP calculation: explode BOMs, check available stock, generate planned orders for shortages. For items with BOMs, creates manufacture planned orders. For raw materials, creates purchase planned orders.

service-call.name: create#zenith.erp.manufacturing.MrpRun
service-call.in-map: [facilityId: facilityId, runDate: ec.user.nowTimestamp, planningHorizonDays: planningHorizonDays, runByUserId: ec.user.userId]

service.description: Convert a firmed planned manufacturing order into an actual work order.

return.message: Only manufacture planned orders can be converted to work orders

service-call.name: create#zenith.erp.manufacturing.WorkOrder
service-call.in-map: [productId: plannedOrder.productId, bomId: plannedOrder.bomId, routingId: routing?.routingId, quantity: plannedOrder.plannedQuantity, plannedStartDate: plannedOrder.plannedStartDate, plannedEndDate: plannedOrder.requiredDate, facilityId: plannedOrder.facilityId, statusId: 'WoDraft', priority: plannedOrder.priority ?: 'Normal', notes: 'Auto-generated from MRP Run ' + (plannedOrder.mrpRunId ?: '')]

service-call.name: create#zenith.erp.manufacturing.WorkOrderMaterial
service-call.in-map: [workOrderId: workOrderId, productId: bi.productId, plannedQuantity: matQty, uomId: bi.uomId]

service.description: Calculate work center capacity utilization for the planning period.
